rfp.description: Strong reference to the rfp record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.rfp).

config.description: Strong reference to any config information that needs to be processed by rfp actor prior to bid accept (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.config.wif.simple).

payload.description: Strong reference to the bid record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.bids.x402).
